definitions.gloss: state-owned land; land owned by the national government
definitions.explanation: Land whose owner is the national government rather than a private individual or company. Often discussed in the context of sales to the private sector, public projects, or administrative management.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国有地|こくゆうち}だ。
{国有地|こくゆうち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売買|ばいばい}→売買：04336_baibai⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: State-owned land cannot, as a rule, be freely bought or sold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国有地|こくゆうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{民間|みんかん}→民間：13260_minkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{払|はら}い{下|さ}げられた。
examples.english: The state-owned land in front of the station was sold off to a private company.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{国有|こくゆう}→国有：28390_kokuyuu⟧ (state-owned) + {地|ち} (land). Contrasts with privately held land.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国有地|こくゆうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧: sale of state-owned land
- {国有地|こくゆうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{払|はら}い{下|さ}げる: to sell off state-owned land (to the private sector)
- {国有地|こくゆうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: management of state-owned land

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{私有地|しゆうち}→私有地：22702_shiyuuchi⟧: privately owned land — owned by an individual or company
- ⟦{公有地|こうゆうち}→公有地：29445_kouyuuchi⟧: publicly owned land — owned by a local government or public body
